title: mors.ask (event)
description: Help asked through Doto, with the message as it stands. kind "spell": the human wants to say question (the words they typed); answer with mors.suggest {rev, text, reason: "spell"} so the letters show as a ghost for them to key. kind "check": read morse yourself and say in one line what you read; if a group is off, say which and what it should be, and do not fix it unless they ask. kind "free": a plain question from the full controller's Ask box; answer in chat, and in Morse on the tape when it fits (mors.play).

kind.description: spell = Spell a word for me; check = Check what I keyed; free = a question typed in the full controller's Ask box.

question.description: For spell, the words the human typed. For check, the word "check". For free, their question.

source.description: menu = picked from Doto's menu; form = typed into a one-line form (the spell line under the toolbar, or the Ask box).

rev.description: Message revision; starts at 1 on an empty tape and never goes down. Send it back with mors.suggest.

morse.description: The message as elements: . and - only, letters separated by a space, words by " / ". At most 4 000 elements; the limit here counts the separators too.

text.description: The window's decode, uppercase, words separated by one space. # marks a group that is not in the table; prosigns read <AR>, <SK>, <SOS>.

view.description: Which of Doto's extras are open. key is the minimum.

controller.description: key is the minimum; full is the full controller.

readback.description: The decoded characters are shown on the tape.
